beats.html:
1, Giles Corey, was pressed
to death under stones.

The burning is the detail
everyone repeats, and it is
the one detail that is wrong.

Worth asking what else
you are repeating.

clip.match_reason: Giles Corey was pressed to death under stones, and the plate is an open New England hillside in late autumn with those same loose field stones lying in the grass under bare oaks.
